meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多步任务变成持久化进度清单，清空对话后也能恢复。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要AI处理多步骤任务，并担心上下文丢失导致重来。
copy.tagline_en: Turn multi-step tasks into persistent progress lists that survive conversation clears.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often use AI for multi-step tasks and fear losing progress when context clears.

howto.what: 它会为多步任务在磁盘上维护 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件，把计划、发现、进度存下来。对话被 /clear 清空后，Claude 能自动找回这些文件继续干活；计划文件里的内容只被当数据，夹带的指令会被拦截。
howto.when: 当被要求规划、拆解或组织多步骤项目、研究任务，或任何需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时。存在计划文件时，每次对话和工具调用都会自动附上当前计划内容。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目拆成步骤，先建任务计划。
say.note: Claude 会创建 task_plan.md 并开始规划。

say.text: 把刚才查到的资料记进 findings.md。
say.note: Claude 会把新发现写入文件防丢失。

say.text: 清空上下文后，接着做之前的计划。
say.note: Claude 从磁盘找回计划并继续执行。

howto.what_en: Claude keeps three files on disk — task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md — storing plan, discoveries, and progress. After a /clear, it re-reads them to resume. It treats plan-file content as data and blocks embedded instructions.
howto.when_en: When asked to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work needing 5+ tool calls. With an active plan file, it attaches the plan to every prompt and tool call.

say_en.text: Break this project into steps and create a task plan first.
say_en.note: Claude creates task_plan.md and starts planning.

say_en.text: Log the current research findings into findings.md.
say_en.note: Claude writes new discoveries to the file.

say_en.text: After clearing context, resume the previous plan.
say_en.note: Claude finds the plan on disk and continues it.
